prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a side-impact collision between two passenger vehicles. Driver 1 was operating a silver sedan northbound and stated the traffic signal had been green. Driver 2 was operating a red SUV westbound and stated the signal was yellow upon entry. The front driver's side of the SUV struck the passenger side of the sedan. Airbag deployment was noted in the sedan. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of the sedan and was uninjured. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness and was evaluated at the scene by EMS. Driver 1 declined transport at that time. Both vehicles sustained disabling damage and were towed from the scene. Traffic control was maintained by the responding officer until the lanes were cleared. Photographs and witness information were collected for the file.
